scope: Seven verified primary-source statements only. These are not seven fully verified products, a complete current-law reconciliation, or commercial release approvals.

facts.title: Contaminants Version IX document authenticated
facts.finding: Actual captured document identifies Version IX, resolving the earlier VIII/IX retrieval ambiguity for this capture. Every commodity mapping still requires separate validation.

facts.title: May 2026 contaminant amendment commencement
facts.finding: Clause 1(2) explicitly specifies 1 December 2026. Do not activate the May amendments on 2 November. Preserve the correct December date already in batch47; an unrelated January 2027 guard does not override this source.

facts.title: Coffee-chicory front-of-pack direction
facts.finding: The direction keeps the earlier coffee-chicory notification in abeyance. Revised front-of-pack coffee/chicory percentage declarations have a minimum 1 mm font height, or 2 mm where PDP exceeds 100 cm². Paragraph 3 sets 1 July 2027. All other applicable labelling requirements remain separately applicable.

facts.title: Withdrawn fruit-content analytical method
facts.manual: Manual of Methods of Analysis of Foods - Fruit and Vegetable Products
facts.finding: This named method is withdrawn immediately. Pending an approved revised method, laboratories may adopt an appropriately validated method from the recognised authorities listed in the order. No automatic substitute method number is assigned. Do not block unrelated methods numbered 2.11 in other manuals.

facts.title: Pan masala packaging amendment
facts.finding: The final amendment takes effect on Gazette publication, 10 August 2026. The inserted Pan Masala entry lists plastic-free and aluminium/metallised-layer-free paper/paperboard/cellulose/naturally derived materials, or tin/glass containers, and references the stated Plastic Waste Management Rules provisions. This is product-specific, not a general packaging ban for other foods.

facts.title: Meat-sausage compliance extension is time-limited
facts.finding: The direction grants six months from 1 May 2026. That period does not extend beyond October 2026. No later extension was found in the searched official index/results; absence of a search result is not proof that no later direction exists. Do not treat this April extension as indefinitely active on 2 November 2026.

facts.title: Dried fruit/vegetable seeds: licensing route, not an invented standard
facts.finding: The order assigns edible dried fruit seeds to 4.1.2.2 and vegetable seeds to 4.2.2.2 for General Manufacturing licensing until a specific standard is notified. It explicitly said no specific standard had then been prescribed. Do not convert a later draft proposal into an operative numeric standard without a final notification.
